Node.Description: Go to Accounts receivable > Customers > All customers.
In the list, find and select the desired record.
In the list, click the link in the selected row.
On the Action Pane, click Projects.
Use the shortcut for switching to View or Edit mode.
In the Last name field, type a value.
In the Name or description field, type a value.
In the Street field, type a value.
In the City field, enter or select a value.
In the list, click the link in the selected row.
Select Yes in the Primary field.
On the Action Pane, click Sell.
